prompt:
Panoramic cinematic dark-fantasy digital illustration, banner composition, 21:9. High contrast, sharp hard-surface and soft-texture detailing: weathered leather, dense plumage, tree bark, glittering nails, polished brass. Palette: obsidian black and slate grey shadows, with neon magenta-violet magic light, radiant emerald green nature glow, and molten orange-red lava light from below. Dynamic triangular action composition sweeping left to right with clear foreground, midground and background depth.
Setting: a deep cavern floor of cracked black obsidian tiles; bright fiery orange magma glows through the cracks and rim-lights every figure's legs and underbellies from below.
Center-left foreground, main focal point: a heavyset athletic man in his late twenties, 6'3", broad thick-set build with dense shoulder and chest muscle, short messy dark hair, gritted teeth and an intense forward glare, light sweat sheen and combat scuffs. He wears an unzipped distressed dark-brown leather jacket over his bare chest, its front and sleeves covered in rectangular velcro patches of many colors with embroidered symbols; plain white knit boxer shorts printed with small scattered bright-red hearts, hems smudged with dirt; thick dark leather kneepads with cast-iron plates and three short triangular spikes; black fingerless tactical gloves. Completely bare, dirt-stained feet with glossy silver-and-pink glitter toenails and a thin gold ring on the second toe of each foot. A black-ink goblin skull tattoo on his right inner forearm and a small jagged blade tattoo on the left side of his neck. Low forward combat stride, right arm pulled back about to hurl a round antique bronze hand grenade trailing faint green smoke and glowing runes, left arm raised defensively.
Center-right foreground, second focal point: a pony-sized feathered velociraptor sprinting parallel to the man, kicking up stone dust, long horizontal body and long rigid tail, narrow snout with small serrated teeth, jaws wide open in a roar showing a dark red tongue, dark intelligent eyes with slit pupils, large curved sickle claws raised on its hind feet. Fully feathered, no bare scales: deep crimson back and head with a tall rigid red-and-blue feather crest down the neck, vivid electric-blue flanks and belly.
Riding the raptor in a small dark-leather saddle: a very fluffy long-haired tortoiseshell Persian cat with black, cream and ginger patches, flat smushed face, tiny snub nose, large round yellow eyes wide with manic aggression. She wears a tiny polished silver jeweled tiara with smoky grey gems and a central teardrop purple amethyst, a flexible silver scale-mail skirt over her hindquarters with her fluffy tail through a slot, and a deep red velvet collar with a silver butterfly pendant. Standing in small stirrups, left front paw holding leather reins, right front paw raised and thrust toward the viewer, the bursting orb of neon magenta arcane magic forming directly at the tip of the cat's own paw, not at the raptor's claws, that throws hot pink highlights across the raptor's red feathers.
Top center, floating in mid-air above the man and the cat: the hollow severed head of a grown woman's latex mannequin, an adult woman in her thirties with mature adult proportions, defined cheekbones, a strong adult jawline and a long neck stump, clearly not a child and not a baby doll, with bleached platinum-blonde synthetic hair in two messy pigtails tied with frayed pink ribbon, smeared electric-blue eyeshadow, oversized false eyelashes and smudged bright-pink lipstick, visible mold seams on the jaw, scuffs and small cracks, and coarse black thread stitches closing a tear on her left cheek. Tilted downward, jaw unhinged wide in a hollow scream releasing ripples of glowing yellow sonic shockwaves.
Left midground, behind the man: a towering ten-foot tree elemental built of thick dark oak bark, gnarled root bundles and heartwood, with massive pauldron-like wooden shoulders, moss, lichen and small white and pink wildflowers along her spine, arms and head, and a gentle mature woman's face carved into the wood with softly glowing emerald eyes. Both root-hands slammed onto the floor, making leafy green vines burst up through the cracked stone; emerald light washes over the man's back.
Right flank midground, on an elevated stone ledge in shadow behind the raptor's tail: a slender changeling assassin with smooth hairless chalk-white skin, no eyebrows, small nostril slits, no ears, and solid glossy black almond eyes, in fitted matte-black leather armor with charcoal wraps on the forearms and boots, hood pushed back, crouched low with twin curved steel daggers in a reverse grip, blade tips dripping viscous purple liquid.
Exactly one cat in the entire image: the Persian riding the raptor. No other cats, kittens or animals besides the raptor. Keep the upper corners and the far right background darker and calmer for overlays. No text, no letters, no numbers, no words, no logos, no watermark, no signature, no user interface.
